metadata.description: Ambition skill: raise a task on one of three axes (Altitude, Depth, Range) and rewrite it as a prompt with an outside judge. Deeper, not bigger. English canonical, replies follow the user's language.

plugins.name: ambition
plugins.description: Pre-flight skill that raises a task's ambition before it runs. Triages the axis (Altitude: the outcome behind the task; Depth: a top professional's raw material, methods and outside judge; Range: other fields and their instruments), then rewrites the task as one prompt and stops. Based on Felix Rieseberg's 2026 tutorial. Replies follow the user's language.
